metric: native-window input to first verified photo response (firstMs)

RAWMaster.driver: typed numeric commit through the shipping EditingController; nonactivating background AppKit canvas

LightFlow.driver: Trusted Return on prepared LightFlow numeric control through local Chrome DevTools; reads committed slider value

inputBoundaries.RAWMaster: Complete numeric intent submitted to the shipping editing controller
inputBoundaries.LightFlow: Return sent with the full value already prepared in LightFlow's numeric field
inputBoundaries.Camera Raw: First numeric key sent, followed by the remaining characters and Tab; the driver sleeps 9 ms per character

scope: Common physical FIT geometry and display endpoint with the recorded input boundary for each product
